newsitem.title: FRANCE: Delivery sought on December sugar positions -MATIF.
newsitem.headline: Delivery sought on December sugar positions -MATIF.

text.p: Operators sought physical delivery on all 130 positions outstanding on the now expired December sugar contract, French futures exchange MATIF said on Monday.
The December contract expired on November 15.
The lots translate into 6,500 tonnes of sugar on the physical market.
A MATIF spokeswoman said the sugar was priced at $304.50 per tonne and the port of delivery chosen was Gdansk in Poland.
The seller was Node Langlois and the buyer Commerciale DWD.
